projects.name: Meta Global AI
projects.baseline: Uploaded plan reports application submitted Oct 13 and four offline prototypes. No current acceptance, running entry or submission was verified. “Track 2” is the internal idea label; the official participation track is Indie developer.
projects.rules: Acceptance is required. Applications close Oct 25 at 10:59 PM Central (or earlier at capacity); notifications are due Oct 26 at 8 AM Central. Submission closes Nov 4 at 8 PM Central. Rules must be accepted by selected participants; public waiver text was not retrievable. Finals Nov 9.
projects.next: Confirm acceptance + applicable terms; prove one real-model pipeline run.
projects.risk: Do not treat expected approval as received. Keep the Living Table concept separate until organizer/disclosure questions are resolved.

projects.name: Unity Game Jam
projects.baseline: Uploaded plan describes a shell, but no distinct jam project or tested WebGL build was found in the reviewed workspace. Living Table cannot be counted as the new Unity jam game.
projects.rules: New Unity game; no prior-jam game. Submit on itch with build, controls, description, team and credits; disclose generative AI use. Upload limit 1 GB. Deadline Nov 14 at 6 AM Central. Freeze files during judging through Dec 7; results Dec 10. Official rules link still pending. Start-time and voting-window text conflict.
projects.next: Test an empty export; verify rules and exact start; build only in the jam window.
projects.risk: The source’s prebuilt menu → gameplay → win/lose shell is not automatically allowed. Prepare tooling, not the game.

projects.name: Epic AI MegaJam
projects.baseline: Unreal is the uploaded plan’s selected engine. No packaged jam build or toolchain verification was found in reviewed project records. Full Box rules could not be retrieved in this research pass.
projects.rules: Theme Nov 11 at 1 PM Central; build opens Nov 11 at 11 PM Central (Nov 12 Eastern). Close Nov 15 at 7:59 PM Central. Choose Unreal or UEFN. Declare premade materials. Unreal needs a packaged build and 30–60 second video; devlog is optional unless entering Glass Box. Winners by Jan 29.
projects.next: Verify empty-project packaging and full rules; build a tiny theme game in the window.
projects.risk: Uploaded Nov 12 daily card places opening one day late. Declaring a prebuilt game does not make early gameplay development compliant.

projects.name: Living Table
projects.baseline: Updated Oct 29: chess rules, local AI, saved sessions and handoff regression checks exist. General build 0.6.3 is installed; separate chess profile 0.4.0 exists. Real-board acceptance, measured performance and judging access remain unverified.
projects.rules: Official rules rechecked Oct 29. See the current chess rundown for submission gates and evidence. Membership, division, final content audit and judging-channel access remain open.
projects.next: Run the 29-check chess rundown: physical handoff, first-five-minute usability, then final judging package.
projects.risk: Return from virtual play currently requires a manual physical check. Automatic reconciliation remains a blocker for the frictionless claim. Keep the contest package separately audited.

phases.title: Foundation & lockdown
phases.original: Muse marks 7 of 13 foundation tasks complete and logs setup on Oct 5. Application submitted is not approval. The design freeze and anchor-persistence exit test were still open.
phases.current: Unity 6.0 (6000.3.9f1), Meta XR 207, a configured Git remote, and a working APK exist. No MRUK package was found in the current manifest/lockfile; the code uses OVRSpatialAnchor. Today’s new Unity source folders are untracked.
phases.next: Confirm eligibility, freeze the rules and physical-piece workflow, commit and back up the current source, and validate the on-device foundation.

phases.title: Table & hands
phases.original: Original gate: drift below 2 cm at 5 minutes; hand-release move registration; hover/preview; two seated hands-only runs.
phases.current: Grid, fingertip pinch selection, anchor save/restore, and repositioning are coded. The current gesture is pinch-to-select then pinch-to-move virtual pieces. No physical-piece release binding, drift measurements, per-attempt accuracy log, hover preview, or fiducial path is verified.
phases.next: Measure anchoring on two tables and implement/test the chosen physical-piece confirmation flow. Do not treat virtual movement as physical-piece tracking.

phases.title: The living layer
phases.original: Original gate: animation, captures, score, spatial audio, beatable AI, and a complete round a newcomer can follow.
phases.current: Jump animations, landing pulse, selection color, move counter, and breathing frame exist. A move counter is not score or round state. Rules, turns, captures, victory, spatial audio, and AI are absent from the delivered game runtime.
phases.next: Build one complete ruleset and round first, then AI and concise audio/visual feedback.

phases.title: Game feel & session
phases.original: Original gate: 5–10 minute rounds, launch under 30 seconds, pause/removal recovery, hands-only onboarding, pass-and-play.
phases.current: No complete game round exists to time. Reset and layout switching exist; they do not satisfy pause/resume, onboarding, or pass-and-play.
phases.next: Reach a legal start-to-finish round before tuning pacing. Recover session state and add the handoff flow.

phases.title: Polish & performance
phases.original: Original gate: sustained 72 fps, comfort/accessibility controls, clean install, frozen candidate.
phases.current: APK compilation and an update install succeeded. There is no recorded FPS profile, fresh-install play session, or comfort/accessibility acceptance. 978 build warnings remain untriaged.
phases.next: Profile actual Quest sessions, close reliability defects, add readable/seated controls, and freeze by Nov 9.

phases.title: Playtest
phases.original: Original gate: at least five external testers; ranked issue fixes; two retests proving self-service.
phases.current: No external test reports or completed current-build headset checks have been recorded in the project chat.
phases.next: Recruit ahead of time, test five people without coaching, fix issues by severity, and retest at least two.

phases.title: Submission
phases.original: Original gate: tested candidate, trailer, screenshots, full entry; submit Nov 16–17.
phases.current: A local APK is available and installed. No Competition channel invite, public demo video, final entry, or submission confirmation has been verified.
phases.next: Prepare judge access through the Competition channel, finish media and entry, submit Nov 17, and retain Nov 18 as emergency time.
